limitations: Nominal MIDI reference, not measured framewise F0.
Sample-library notes, not live microphone or continuous singing.
NSynth subset, not an exhaustive instrument benchmark; no training performed.
No warmup exclusion; attack contains causal model settling.
Reference mask fixed from clean audio; excluded quiet frames are not voiced ground truth.
Timing is offline inference only, not end-to-end latency.
